plan: Index the catalog into a name -> options map, each option list sorted by (priority, catalog position) so the lowest priority wins with authored order as tie-breaker; picking options[0] makes every choice deterministic.

Resolve an excluded ingredient with a chain walker: repeatedly apply the best catalog choice while the current name is excluded, accumulating quantity factors multiplicatively, last-writer-wins unit/preparation, and appended wording changes, equipment additions/removals, and additional ingredients; a visited set detects a reintroduced excluded name and yields 'substitution cycle involving NAME'.

Process each ingredient list through a work queue: scale every quantity by target_yield / recipe yield (all Fractions), run excluded names through the chain resolver, and push any additional ingredients from a substitution back onto the queue so they receive the same scaling, exclusion checks, and catalog choices (chained adaptation); a step cap guards runaway ingredient-introduction loops.

Collect results per list in an 'effects' record (ingredients, choices, warnings, reasons, wording pairs, equipment deltas). The main list merges unconditionally; an optional component whose effects contain reasons is dropped with a warning instead of merging, while a mandatory component's reasons propagate.

Accumulate all failure reasons in a set rather than short-circuiting: every 'no substitution for NAME' and cycle from ingredient processing, plus one 'equipment NAME unavailable' per item of the post-substitution equipment set not covered by available_equipment. Any reason means possible=False with recipe=None and sorted reasons.

On success, build the adapted recipe from a deep copy: yield set to target_yield, adapted ingredient lists installed, equipment sorted, and all collected wording {old,new} pairs applied to every instruction string (main and kept components) via str.replace.
Guarantee non-mutation by deep-copying the recipe and every queued ingredient before editing; print_original simply returns authored_text unchanged.
mechanisms: catalog index sorted by (priority, position) for deterministic substitution choice
chain resolver with visited-set cycle detection and multiplicative quantity factors
work-queue ingredient pipeline so additional ingredients re-enter exclusion/catalog handling
per-list effects record enabling sandboxed optional components
set-based reason accumulation reporting all independent impossibilities
global wording-pair rewrite over instruction strings
